# A wrapped-option function value bound in a package with no lowering
# edit must cross the export boundary as rt.Option[E]. The importer
# restores the function through the option facts while the bound local
# is erased by the export writer; the two must agree or the reader
# rejects the assignment as a shape mismatch.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd src
logos build ./...
logos lint ./...
logos run ./cmd
stderr 'bound false: true'
stderr 'bound true: false'
stderr 'direct false: true'
stderr 'direct true: false'

-- src/go.mod --
module example.com/optfuncvalue

go 1.27

-- src/beta/beta.lgo --
package beta

func GetOpt(make bool) int? {
	if !make {
		return nil
	}
	return 41
}

func IsNil(v int?) bool {
	return v == nil
}

-- src/use/use.lgo --
package use

import "example.com/optfuncvalue/beta"

// This package spells no option type and uses no option expression,
// so lowering makes no edit and the inferred function value type
// reaches the export writer as written by the first check.
func Bound(make bool) bool {
	f := beta.GetOpt
	return beta.IsNil(f(make))
}

func Direct(make bool) bool {
	return beta.IsNil(beta.GetOpt(make))
}

-- src/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/optfuncvalue/use"

func show(tag string, v bool) {
	if v {
		println(tag + ": true")
	} else {
		println(tag + ": false")
	}
}

func main() {
	show("bound false", use.Bound(false))
	show("bound true", use.Bound(true))
	show("direct false", use.Direct(false))
	show("direct true", use.Direct(true))
}
